descriptionTemplate:
The cognitive failure detector found $failureName ($code) in session $sessionId, with $confidence confidence, at $occurrences point(s) of the trace.
Reasoning: $reasoning
kgQuery: WITH s, r, CASE r.confidence WHEN 'high' THEN 3 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS rank
WITH s, r.code AS code, collect(r)[0] AS best, count(r) AS occurrences
CASE best.confidence WHEN 'high' THEN 'P1' WHEN 'medium' THEN 'P2' ELSE 'P3' END AS priority
